scripts.db:init: node -e "const mysql = require('mysql2/promise'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); (async () => { const conn = await mysql.createConnection({host:process.env.DB_HOST||'localhost',user:process.env.DB_USER||'root',password:process.env.DB_PASSWORD||'',multipleStatements:true}); const sql = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'server','schema.sql'),'utf8'); await conn.query(sql); console.log('Database initialized'); await conn.end(); })()"
